originalEntry.title: Creepy pizza parlor music video
originalEntry.author: ParanoidAmerica
originalEntry.description: A 2-minute-21-second lyric-synced music video mixing Monty Python-style cutouts with ballpoint sketches; Opus made the art through a local ComfyUI with SDXL.
originalEntry.description_zh: 2 分 21 秒、按歌词同步的 MV，拼贴风混圆珠笔速写；画面由 Opus 调本地 ComfyUI 和 SDXL 生成。
originalEntry.prompt: create a music video for this entire song, check lyrics.txt to sync the visuals to. style should be a mix between monty-python/vox style "postcards in space" mixed with sketchy ballpoint pen style visuals. this needs to look professional. theme of the video is a creepy evil pizza parlor, camera starts outside and works through the inside, through a secret bookshelf door into a basement with untold horrors and pizza sauce all over the place. use whatever tools or methods you need to make this look professional. final export should be an .mp4 of the entire music video.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 为这整首歌做一支 MV，参照 lyrics.txt 让画面与歌词同步。风格要把 monty-python/vox 那种 "postcards in space" 风格和潦草的圆珠笔速写风格混在一起。它需要看起来很专业。MV 的主题是一家诡异邪恶的披萨店，镜头从店外开始，一路深入店内，穿过一扇书架暗门，进入一个满是难以言说的恐怖、到处都是披萨酱的地下室。用任何你需要的工具或方法，让它看起来专业。最终导出为整支 MV 的 .mp4。
originalEntry.note: Author: one shot, 67 minutes total, no post-production.
originalEntry.note_zh: 作者称一次生成，总共 67 分钟，没有做后期。

styleClassificationSource.prompt:
create a music video for this entire song, check lyrics.txt to sync the visuals to. style should be a mix between monty-python/vox style "postcards in space" mixed with sketchy ballpoint pen style visuals. this needs to look professional. theme of the video is a creepy evil pizza parlor, camera starts outside and works through the inside, through a secret bookshelf door into a basement with untold horrors and pizza sauce all over the place. use whatever tools or methods you need to make this look professional. final export should be an .mp4 of the entire music video.

claude/opus 5.5 detected comfyui on my system, generated all the assets with SDXL and then composited and animated it all together.

Even if I had all of the art assets and timeline markers, this would have easily taken be 8-10+ hours in After Effects to do manually.

I might never open After Effects again.
